units.source_text: “那就不必特意麻烦狗店老板再来一趟了。

en.t: Then there is no need to trouble the dog-shop owner to come all the way back again.

units.source_text: 话音刚落，她这才想起还没有给狗店老板支付媒妁费，

en.t: No sooner had she said this than she remembered she had not yet paid the dog-shop owner his matchmaking fee,

units.source_text: 便赶紧把狗店老板叫到里面来，递给他一张面值十元的钞票。

en.t: so she quickly called him inside and handed him a ten-yuan banknote.

units.source_text: 正在这时，小宠犬跑了进来，小姐正在扣大衣的纽扣。

en.t: Just then, the little pet dog ran in, while the young lady was buttoning her overcoat.

units.source_text: 小宠犬尖锐地吠吼，并纵身跳到夫人的膝上。

en.t: The little dog barked sharply and sprang onto the lady's lap.

units.source_text: 因为夫人手里拿着小姐的白狐围脖。

en.t: It was because the lady was holding the young lady's white fox stole in her hands.
